wins.label: Strong Q1 Performance
wins.evidence: We reported net income of $4.1 billion and earnings per share of $1.96 with an ROTCE of 9.1%. Overall, it was a strong quarter, marked by continued momentum in each of our 5 businesses.

wins.label: Expense Discipline
wins.evidence: We maintained a disciplined approach to our expenses, which declined by 5% year-over-year. We delivered our third consecutive quarter of positive operating leverage for each of our 5 lines of business.

wins.label: Capital Returns
wins.evidence: We returned $2.8 billion in capital to our shareholders including $1.75 billion of buybacks as part of our $20 billion plan, which is about $250 million more than we had originally guided.

wins.label: Strategic Transformation Progress
wins.evidence: Our transformation investments continue to modernize our infrastructure, simplify our processes, and reduce manual touch points.

wins.label: Strong Business Growth
wins.evidence: Services recorded its highest first quarter revenue in a decade. TTS continues to demonstrate momentum in the key underlying drivers across U.S. dollar clearing and cross-border activity.

risks.label: Macro Uncertainty
risks.evidence: The world is in a wait-and-see mode and is facing a more negative macro outlook than anyone had anticipated at the beginning of the year.

risks.label: Credit Risk
risks.evidence: The ACL build reflects uncertainty and deterioration in the macroeconomic outlook, including a further skew to the downside scenario in our CECL framework.

risks.label: Regulatory and Tax Policy Changes
risks.evidence: In the U.S., regulation and tax policy are all likely to look different in a year's time.

risks.label: Credit Losses
risks.evidence: Cost of credit was $2.7 billion, primarily consisting of net credit losses in card as well as a firm-wide net ACL build.

risks.label: Geopolitical Risks
risks.evidence: The changes underway globally will go beyond trade and tariffs. In the U.S., for example, regulation and tax policy are all likely to look different in a year's time.
